notes: Mound is printed 'MOUND'; 60' south of 8th (47' north of 8th). Mound runs slightly SSE south of 7th (centre x 3164 at 7th to 3278 at 6th). At West 6th Mound is offset: the north part (centre x~3278, 60 ft) meets the 6th centreline at (3278,3662); the south part continues SSE (dx/dy ~0.28, centre x~3362 at y3800) and meets it at about (3320,3650); the point given is the midpoint. L'Hommedieu Alley is the narrow street running east from Mound at y~2338 (faces 2318/2359); no name or width is printed on this sheet, the name and 12' width come from sheet 42 (and sheet 43); it does not continue west of Mound. Barr, Kenyon and Wingate Alley all jog at Cutter (same as sheet 40): east of Cutter Barr is centred y~2502 (40'), Kenyon 3199, Wingate Alley 3660; west of Cutter (drawn in outline, sheet 40 area) Barr 2593 (50'), Kenyon 3332, Wingate Alley 3765 (20'); each branch recorded as a T on its side of Cutter. Barr, George and Kenyon end at Mound (T). George enters from the east on a slant (centre slope ~-0.27). Wingate Alley width label at Cutter is partly hidden ('8'' visible, measured ~18 ft at Cutter, narrowing to ~14 ft toward its east end); width left null. Park Street (printed 'PARK', no width) leaves West 6th to the SSE at the bottom of the sheet (faces ~1800/1931 at the 6th south face) and is a T at 6th. West 6th is diagonal with both faces drawn; Cutter ends at it (T). Both faces of West 8th drawn (y~711/918). NAMING (to match sheets 40 and 42): the pieces east of Cutter are 'Barr Street (east of Cutter)', 'Kenyon Avenue (east of Cutter)' and 'Wingate Alley (east of Cutter)'; the pieces west of Cutter keep the plain names except the straight Wingate branch, 'Wingate Alley (Jane to Cutter)'.
